subject: Post-call recap: pricing & token volumes — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reynolds <samantha@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: pricing & token volumes — next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today, Samantha — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned: 

1) Volume assumptions (as discussed)
- Pilot: 0.5B tokens/month (initial 1–2 months)
- Ramp: ~2B tokens/month by month 6 if usage trends hold
- Long-term target: 3–5B tokens/month (18–24 months)

2) Unit economics / target pricing
- You mentioned a target range of ~$20–$30 per 1M tokens as a workable benchmark for the team.
- To translate: at 2B tokens/mo (2000M tokens), $20/1M -> ~$40k/mo; $25/1M -> ~$50k/mo.

3) Budget & stakeholders
- You indicated there is a centralized LLM budget bucket and that Thomas Wu (CTO) is the economic buyer.
- Finance contact for approvals appears to be Elena Morales (cc'd by you on procurement threads).
- Procurement contact: procurement@acme-ai.com (please confirm).

4) Next steps I can own
- Attached: preliminary pricing estimate + 1M-token cost breakdown (redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf).
- Can prepare a formal quote with tiered volume discounts and an option for Dedicated capacity if you want committed capacity/SLA.
- Proposed next meeting: procurement + finance + Thomas to review quote and finalize approval. I can do Tues 14th or Wed 15th afternoon PT — please confirm.

Ask: can you confirm the economic buyer (Thomas) and finance approver (Elena) so I can include them on the procurement meeting invite? Also confirm whether the $20–$25/1M token range aligns with your internal thresholds.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (summary), redwood-1M-token-cost-breakdown.xlsx (detailed unit economics)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Thomas Wu (CTO) — he'll sign off on the strategic spend.
- Finance approver: Elena Morales (Finance Director) — handles budget sign-off for new vendor contracts.
- Procurement: procurement@acme-ai.com will coordinate contract/PO.

Volume confirmation: the pilot will be ~500M tokens/mo (limited user set), with an expected ramp to ~2B within six months. Longer-term we expect to be in the 3–4B range if the integration performs well.

Budget / target pricing: our current guidance for LLM infra is roughly $15k–$50k/month depending on value delivered. For a self-service hosted API, the finance team would prefer a target around $20–$25 per 1M tokens for the initial committed tier. Dedicated/reserved capacity would be considered if unit economics and SLA justify it.

Next steps: please go ahead and prepare a formal quote (tiered pricing + optional Dedicated pricing). We'll loop Thomas, Elena, and procurement on the procurement call — suggest Tue 14th 10:00am PT. If that works for your team, please send calendar invite and a one-page summary for exec review.

Thanks,
Samantha Reynolds
Head of Product Integrations | Acme AI
samantha@acme-ai.com
